question: Who set a new national record in the men’s 10,000 metres at the Ten 2025 athletics meet held in San Juan Capistrano, USA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulveer Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gulveer Singh** shattered the national record in the **men’s 10,000 metres** during **"The TEN"** athletics meet held in **San Juan Capistrano, California, USA**.
 
• He clocked a remarkable time of **27:41.81**, significantly improving upon the previous long-standing Indian record. ***Hence, the statement regarding the record holder is correct.***
 
• The previous national record of **28:02.89** was held by **Surendra Singh**, which had remained unbeaten since **2008**. **Gulveer Singh** managed to shave off nearly **21 seconds** from the 16-year-old mark.
 
• By achieving this feat at the high-profile **California** meet, **Gulveer Singh** finished second in his heat, demonstrating his growing prowess in long-distance running on the international stage.
 
• The performance was part of a targeted effort by **Indian athletes** to qualify for major international championships, including the **Olympics** and World Athletics C
